'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
